race.comment: Plenty of first starters to make it a little tricky but KAYLA KRUZEN (5) has some good form on the board. Was racing in richer maidens in first campaign placing in 4/6 starts. Trialling well leading into this and looks hard to beat. NEVER PEGASUS (2) was well in the market on debut at Murray Bridge and kept coming to place. Sure to be improved and should be in the finish again. YOURWORSTNIGHTMARE (9) is a colt by Doubtland making his first appearance. Unbeaten in two trials and expected to be well fancied to open his winning account at first outing. DANCEABLE (4) stormed home on debut and despite the draw can be doing the same again.
